author: Claude

floor.source: 6d14f52 (trial merge of fcd95a2, dark variance floor)

corpus: every CR3/CR2 at the root of tests/image/base-hors-protocole (76 files), no Lightroom reference
method: neutral IPR render through iprRenderServer, states lum/col/sharp; masks dark/mid_flat/bright_flat/edges from the first neutral render (state 0/0/0 identical for the three versions, checked); metrics of strength_law.py (Rec.709 luma, Gaussian sigma 2 high-pass, chroma R-G/B-G); dots = share of mask pixels whose 8-bit R-G or B-G departs by more than 12 from a 9x9 median; zones under 2000 pixels left out
